name: Isomorphic Node Recycling (DAOG)
definition: A compression method that reuses structurally identical (isomorphic) nodes by converting the Octree into a Directed Acyclic Octal Graph (DAOG).
summary: Isomorphic Node Recycling converts Sparse Voxel Octrees into Directed Acyclic Octal Graphs to reduce memory by reusing identical subtrees via structure-dependent hashing.
